title: Self-serve report onboarding pathways and priority bands
creator: Ravi Shah
description: Create a lightweight, tiered onboarding experience and prioritization bands for incoming console/reporting requests so customers can self-serve common analytics and export needs while high-touch requests are routed to Solutions/Eng with clear SLAs. This ticket scopes the intake form, routing rules, SLA ladder, onboarding documentation, and a short-term enforcement mechanism (manual triage queue) while we build automation in a follow-on engineering epic.
acceptance_criteria: A published intake form for console/reporting requests with fields that map to triage scores (MRR, frequency, PII, revenue impact, timeframe, template match).
A documented priority band matrix (Self-Serve, Standard Queue, High-Touch) with target SLAs (24h, 5 business days, 2 business days respectively) and handoff steps.
A set of 4 self-serve report templates (Usage Snapshot, Cost Breakdown, Tenant Export, Token-level Trends) available in the Console help center.
Manual triage playbook created and shared with Solutions Eng and Support for the interim routing phase.
Dashboard (internal) showing queue counts by band and SLA breach alerts for first 30 days of rollout.
triage_rubric: MRR >= $10k OR contract clause requiring SLA => High-Touch
PII or regulated data export => Escalate to Compliance & Private deployment team
Request matches one of the 4 templates AND frequency <= weekly => Self-Serve
Ad-hoc one-off analysis with completion window <=48h and medium revenue impact => Standard Queue (fast lane)
If customer has Dedicated or Private plan => prioritize to same-tenant reporting lane with Solutions Eng coordination
deliverables: Intake form schema (Form + scoring weights) published in Confluence
Self-serve templates and Console help center doc pages
Manual triage runbook and Slack triage channel (#reports-triage)
Internal dashboard: triage-by-band, SLA breaches, avg time-to-fulfill
Kickoff training session recording for Support & Solutions Eng
out_of_scope: Full engineering automation for routing (separate ENG epic)
Large-scale ETL pipeline build for multi-tenant exports
Billing/charging implementation for scheduled paid exports (future work)

implementation_notes: Short term: use a Google Form -> Zapier -> triage Slack channel workflow to collect requests and assign band
Medium term: wire report-orchestrator endpoints to allow automated routing and scheduled exports (ENG milestone).
Use feature flags for rollout: pilot 10 enterprise tenants, then open to all workspaces after 30 days of metrics review.
risks: If templates don't cover common ask patterns, manual queue will balloon — mitigate by analyzing first 50 requests and iterating templates.
SLA commitments may exceed current Solutions Eng capacity — need to quantify effort and consider staffed SLAs or committed tickets per week.
Exports involving PII require Compliance sign-off and could delay fulfillment; ensure early gating in intake form.
